profile.headline: I build practical web products, internal tools, and automation systems for real-world work.
profile.bio: Product Developer & Full-Stack Builder | Building practical web applications, offline-first systems, and automation workflows that solve real problems.

bioParagraphs: I build practical web products, internal tools, and automation systems for real-world work. I’m Zahid Hasan Patwary, a product developer and full-stack builder focused on turning everyday operational bottlenecks into clear, reliable software.

From offline-first restaurant POS platforms (Dhakaiya Bites) and personal finance ledgers (Zahid Finance) to scholarship application command centers (Scholar Quest) and shared-living management systems (The Shared Plate), I build systems people can actually use in production.

My engineering stack centers around React 19, Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, TanStack Query, and offline-first IndexedDB storage. I also design lightweight automation systems and bots leveraging Python, Telegram Bot API, and Google Sheets.

Whether you need a reliable product engineered from scratch, an offline-first architecture, or operational automation to streamline daily workflows, I own the technical roadmap, architecture, and user experience end to end.

experience.description: Architected a full-stack command center helping scholarship applicants organize university shortlists, IELTS preparation, application documents, professor outreach, and deadlines.
bullet_points: One organized scholarship workflow: university shortlists, IELTS tracking, outreach, and document vault in a unified workspace.
Built with React 19, TypeScript, TanStack Router, TanStack Query, and Supabase Row Level Security.
Context-aware mentor experience with intelligent deadline notifications and applicant readiness scoring.

experience.description: Built an offline-first restaurant POS and operations platform for orders, table management, inventory, production costing, staff workflows, payments, reports, and sync-ready data management.
bullet_points: Offline-first POS: handles billing, tables, KOT, and inventory without requiring continuous internet connectivity.
Production costing and staff workflows: tracks ingredient usage, recipe margins, and daily sales summaries.
Sync-ready architecture: automatically pushes batched operational data to Supabase when network is restored.

experience.description: Designing and shipping practical web products for real workflows, including restaurant operations, shared-living finance, personal finance, and community record-keeping.
bullet_points: Shipped 5 production-grade web systems solving specific operational pain points for local businesses and communities.
Engineered scalable database models with PostgreSQL, Row Level Security, and automated timestamp tracking.
Designed accessible, tactile user interfaces using Tailwind CSS with keyboard-first workflows.

experience.description: Created a personal finance and trust-money ledger to track income, expenses, lending, borrowing, held funds, reminders, recurring transactions, approvals, reports, and email-based records.
bullet_points: Relationship-based ledger: separates personal income/expenses from funds held in trust for others or lent out.
Automated financial health overview with net worth calculation, settlement tracking, and payment reminders.
Built as a lightweight, installable PWA for high performance on both mobile and desktop.

experience.description: Built a shared-living management system for meal tracking, grocery and bazar records, member payables, rent, settlements, absence tracking, and monthly reporting.
bullet_points: Shared household ledger: tracks daily meal counts, grocery contributions, utility bills, and individual net balances.
Automated end-of-month settlement reports eliminating manual disputes and ledger calculation errors.
Responsive, mobile-optimized interface with granular member permission roles.

experience.description: Developing lightweight administrative tools and Telegram bots that simplify recurring tasks through structured data capture, reminders, confirmations, reporting, and clear audit-friendly records.
bullet_points: Built Telegram bot workflows automating administrative student attendance and monthly fee collection reminders.
Engineered Google Sheets API sync pipeline for auto-generating weekly financial audit sheets.
Reduced manual administrative workload by over 10 hours weekly.

experience.description: Hand-picked by GymScanner’s CEO to build his next company from day one. I own the architecture and technical roadmap as Bidvers operates in the US, Oman and Romania.
bullet_points: Core platform and API: architected and built them from a blank repo; the team’s iOS and Android apps are built on top.
Bidding engine: built a low-latency, real-time engine on the TALL stack (Tailwind, Alpine.js, Laravel, Livewire).
Payments and vendors: shipped secure payment routing and complex vendor workflows for operations in the US, Oman and Romania.
